data.question_intent: Growth opportunities and synergies in Hang Seng Bank's wealth management business post-privatization
data.question_quote: Could you provide further information about the growth opportunities? I want to know which aspects of the wealth management business will have stronger synergies with Hang Seng Bank, and what are the outlooks for the Wealth balances and Wealth Management margins?
data.answer_quote: Hang Seng Bank will retain its own authorised institution and governance. It will retain its own brand in Hong Kong, of course, as a major community bank and the largest local bank. It will retain an independent customer proposition that will compete in the market for all customers. It will retain its branch network, and that proposition will remain intact with a distinctive cultural strength and customer proposition - customer experience strength - that Hang Seng has been known for practically a century in Hong Kong.
